provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^292 - 1 with a(x) = x^71 + x^79 + x^93 + x^142 + x^183 + x^236 + x^259 + x^268, b(x) = x^84 + x^106 + x^108 + x^149 + x^188 + x^213; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
